source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 众惊追因，疑云更深
title: 众惊追因，疑云更深
purpose: 承接 SC22：拓拔野的反打已经让场面从武力压制变成集体怀疑。此段要把后续气氛拆开：先是众人从震惊转向追问，再是十四郎的受辱恼怒，接着科沙度更明确地锁定幕后相助者，最后把白衣女子那条静而危险的暗线压住。全段继续保持无声视觉，不生成口播、字幕、身份牌或任何可读文本。

continuity_from.source_grounding: E:\workspace\ComfyUIProjects\搜神记.txt gb18030 excerpt around 众惊追问 / 十四郎羞怒 / 科沙度锁定幕后暗助 / 白衣女子静压。

image_reference_policy: Use one strong reference image per storyboard workflow. SH01 and SH02 anchor to the approved SC22 crowd-shock and counterattack aftermath. SH03 anchors to the approved SC22 Keshadu deduction frame. SH04 keeps the same gate-space while shifting emotional weight toward the white-clothed woman under suspicion.
video_policy: If stable reference-driven I2V is unavailable, use Comfy technical still fallback for pipeline continuity and mark outputs non-production. If true I2V is restored, use only the approved storyboard image as source of truth.

localization_policy.screen_text: Do not generate readable text, captions, subtitles, UI, signs, labels, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or clear Chinese inscriptions inside image/video.
localization_policy.dialogue_audio: Do not ask the video model to synthesize spoken dialogue, accusations, or sound effects. Chinese dialogue, narration, and subtitles should be added later in editing.
production_dialogue_lines: 十四郎颜面尽失，羞怒难平。
科沙度越发断定有人在背后相助。
白衣女子越静，杀机越深。
